tex_content.html: \begin{equation} J_{T_0}=\{ s\leq 0:-s<T_0\} =\begin{cases} (-T_0,0],& T_0<\infty ,\\ (-\infty ,0],& T_0=\infty . \end{cases} \end{equation} Long controls additionally require that, for every $0<T<T_0$ and $A>0$, eventually there is an actual compatible cylinder on $(-T,0]\times B_k(A)$, equal to the identity at zero, at every image point of which the flow is $\kappa $-noncollapsed on physical scales at most $r_0$. The threshold in $k$ may depend on $T,A$.
